dimensions.evidenceA: John’s objection treats Jesus as the greater baptizer.
dimensions.evidenceB: John’s testimony makes the Spirit’s sign the point of recognition.
dimensions.label: Recognition language

evidence.observation: John tells Jesus, “I need to be baptized by you,” before Jesus answers and John allows the baptism.
John says he did not recognize Jesus and that the descending and remaining Spirit was the identifying sign.

record.tension: Matthew gives John recognition language before baptism, while John’s Gospel says he did not recognize Jesus until the Spirit’s sign.
record.title: When does John recognize Jesus?
